changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/9ncuT5DP#qTmIytbT
changes.value: A turn that delivered, steered or queued work, or whose delivery may have reached the workhorse, shows in the conversation of each workhorse it reached. A delegation the workhorse refused as busy or with an invalid body gave it nothing, and moves the turn nowhere. A turn that gave work to none shows in the conversation shown while it ran. A turn with no record shows in whatever conversation is shown. The timeline keeps only the turns of the shown conversation before it spends its budget. It also keeps which voice coordinator turn delegated each workhorse turn: a listener on the tab session's workhorse operations records a workhorse turn only from a delegate operation's event that names that turn, because a steer must not mark a turn the user began. It keeps the 256 newest records in the tab session's state. The browser gateway hands that record to the projection of the workhorse timeline, and a recorded turn then carries delegatedBy.
